approval: User explicitly requested real project modifications and selected Studio Orbital. No production deploy/push authorized.
goal: Ship a complete red Studio Orbital landing plus Red Ribbon Chamber pricing page while preserving crawlable content, canonical URLs, working account app, and true commercial terms.
architecture: Laravel Blade server renders public home, /pricing, and three legal pages. A separate Vite vanilla JavaScript/CSS entry progressively enhances motion and controls. React remains for login, dashboard, Chat AI, and admin. Root never becomes a JavaScript-only shell.
seo: Keep https://ultrai.id canonical home and https://ultrai.id/pricing canonical pricing
Preserve incumbent homepage title and core Indonesian product intent
Server HTML contains landing H1/model names/FAQ and pricing H1/all six prices
Page-specific canonical/title/description for pricing and policies
Pricing JSON-LD offers match DurationOrder::PACKAGES; homepage FAQ schema matches visible content
No unsupported aggregate rating or fake purchase notifications
robots remains crawlable and sitemap includes /pricing
No-JavaScript visitors receive the same real content
JavaScript never sets noindex/canonical or hides content pending animation

motion.direction: Red Studio Orbital landing plus Red Ribbon Chamber pricing
motion.hero: Landing keeps the actual UltrAI logo at the center of six branded model orbits. Pricing uses six selectable tickets around a layered red ribbon chamber.
motion.story: Landing preserves the approved composition without inline pricing. Dedicated pricing moves from interactive ribbon selection through six authoritative cards, payment methods, and a closing ribbon.
motion.safety: No manual motion control. Reduced-motion creates a static composition; offscreen/hidden animations pause; real text stays present; no scroll hijacking or infinite offscreen work.

ownership.Main: routes/web.php, React root-route cutover, Vite config, public asset acquisition, header/footer partials, public/home.blade.php, resources/css/landing.css, resources/js/landing.js, browser integration and final validation
ownership.PublicSeo: app/Http/Controllers/PublicSiteController.php, config/marketing.php, resources/views/layouts/public.blade.php, resources/views/public/policy.blade.php, resources/views/public/sitemap.blade.php, tests/Feature/PublicSiteTest.php; replace obsolete ExampleTest only if behavior test replaces it

contract.pricingView: public.pricing extending layouts.public; contains Red Ribbon Chamber, six server-rendered plans, and matching Offer schema

commercialFacts.refund: Existing FAQ: unused new package full refund within24h; technical issue replacement or prorated refund via WhatsApp.

verification: Feature regression checks raw server HTML/SEO offers/policies/sitemap/status and app boundary; production Vite build; browser desktop/mobile/reduced-motion/no-JS; actual timed animation and interaction; no ranking or live Google index guarantee.
